references.text: God's promise to Abraham to make him a great nation (גּוֹי גָּדוֹל), the same promise God now offers Moses
God's promise to Jacob to make him a great nation, parallel to the promise given to Moses
A similar situation where God threatens to destroy the people and make Moses into a great nation
God asks Moses and Aaron to separate themselves from the congregation so He may consume them
Moses recounts God's words about wiping out the people and making Moses into a mightier nation
Moses describes God's burning anger (חַר־אַף) toward Israel
Moses intercedes for the people, and God relents from the disaster He intended to bring upon them
The prophet Jeremiah's reference to God relenting from the evil He had planned to do
The psalmist's description of how Moses stood in the breach to turn away God's wrath
Reference to God's anger and His oath that they would not enter into His rest
